versions.guide:
Find the Demon

The Demon has been seen south of the village of the Sheivars, in a valley encircled by a mountain range twisted like a spiral. The Demon looks like a human but he wears armor unknown on Gipath.

Kill the Demon

If the Demon is killed, Shei-Var will let Airy return home.
versions.html:
Defeating Demon

Shei-Var wishes to give Airy as ransom to a certain demon who is leading the Orcs away. If this Demon is defeated, Shei-Var would free Airy.
